text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] hosted-api(us-east-1) queue growth detected. queued_requests=18420, gpu_pool_util=98%, p95=1.9s p99=6.4s. Autoscaler errors in logs. Paging ops-oncall.
mira (oncall): on it. joining triage now, will gather metrics and runbook. @sam @alex @tia please ack if available.
sam (infra): ack. seeing sustained allocation failures: provisioner returning 429 rate_limit, new instance create failures 00:23-00:45. cloud quotas near-limit for GPUs in us-east-1.
alex (runtime): adding autoscaler logs: "ERROR provisioner: create_instance failed: rate limit" repeated. Autoscaler backoff is exponential but we hit quota so retries don't help. also evictions spiked as pools hit soft-limit.
tia (support): incoming tickets: ~9 customers reporting timeouts, #504s from hosted API, top impacted: customer-analytics, mailchimp-proxy. Escalated to SEs.
mira (oncall): mitigation options: 1) route non-US traffic to eu-west fallback, 2) enable quantized model variants for low-priority work, 3) apply temporary per-org rate-limits + shed background jobs. Thinking 1+2 asap. any objections?
sam (infra): agree. we can flip routing policy for non-US in ~90s. cloud quota request will take hours-days; short-term routing needed. also we can spin up dedicated thin-pool from reserved capacity if legal ok.
alex (runtime): quick command to check autoscaler state:
```
kubectl -n infra logs provisioner-0 --since=15m | grep -E "rate limit|create_instance|quota"
# shows repeated 429s and "quota_exceeded"
```
Warning: restarting provisioner leader will cause lease churn; avoid unless necessary.
mira (oncall): executing routing change now -> enabling fallback-route policy: non-US -> eu-west. also enabling runtime flag `prefer-quantized` for low-priority routes.

mira (oncall): done. routing flipped, quantized variant enabled for route tags: lowprio,batch. pushing soft rate-limits: 200 rps per-org for top noisy orgs.
tia (support): receiving fewer new tickets, but customers still seeing intermittent 504s. notifying top customers about mitigation.
sam (infra): metrics update (01:12 after mitigation): queued_requests=9200, gpu_pool_util=85%, p95=1.2s p99=2.9s. Provisioner still logs 429s but backlog dropping due to routing + quantized.
alex (runtime): verified autoscaler health: leader stable, backlog drained 49% in 10m. created a short-lived surge policy to avoid immediate re-provisioning churn. there's a stuck lease for shard-7, investigating manual release.
mira (oncall): good. continuing to monitor. next steps: 1) open cloud quota emergency with provider (sam) 2) postmortem owner alex for autoscaler retry logic 3) define permanent routing fallback we can flip automatically (mira)
sam (infra): opening quota ticket now, incident ref = INC-1772468101. adding urgency and capacity request. also creating temporary thin-pool from reserved capacity for 2 hours.
tia (support): updated customers: "We've routed traffic and enabled lower-latency fallbacks; we're monitoring and will follow up when fully resolved." Some customers asked for credits; tracking now.
alex (runtime): short-term code notes: need to handle quota_exceeded as a different class: mark pool degraded and trigger policy-based routing earlier. Will submit PR + test tomorrow. also plan to add jitter to autoscaler retries to avoid thundering retries.
mira (oncall): assigning owners: sam -> quota + infra mitigation, alex -> autoscaler bug + postmortem, tia -> customer comms. I'll keep incident open and do 15m cadence updates. anyone hitting anything else? :thinking_face:
sam (infra): thin-pool up, started reserved instances, CPU-level checks pass. continuing to watch provider error rates.
alex (runtime): manual lease release on shard-7 completed, small improvement in allocation success.
incident-bot: update: queued_requests=4400, gpu_pool_util=72%, p95=0.9s p99=1.8s. Incident state: mitigation in-progress, customer impact reduced.
mira (oncall): marking incident as MANAGED (not fully resolved). will create timeline + draft postmortem once stabilized. thanks all for fast response. :thumbsup:
tia (support): closing immediate customer escalation loop, will reopen if regressions show. logging affected customers in support tracker.
